name: core.openwop.workflows.slides-design
description: The slides design workflow (outline → gate → draft → deepen → notes → audit → review), migrated from the deprecated builtin `slides.design` (ADR 0472 P4). Explicit port dataflow + two HITL approval gates (ordering, not conditional). chainId keeps the original id so ignition + replay resolve unchanged; also a gallery-editable chain.
